# R3-pixel frozen tables (generated by gen/r3gen.py; the .txt tables and .tsv predictions are the frozen files)

Sets: control, heldout, repeat (CONFIRM rows of Q276, EVERY ROW READ POST HOC IN ROUND 2 and frozen now, and E769's refuted hypotheses: tallied apart), replicate.  Stage order: p-c3, q-f0, q-f1a, q-f1b, q-t, q-v.  Quantity = value [hypothesis].

## p-c3

Q276 (pixel), frozen rerun of R1's p-c2 (decisions R3-P6 to P8): same job shape and decode as R1's.  Model M (frozen from E772's post hoc
readings and E086): g25 = (x & 1) | (y & 1) << 1 (the lane in a 2x2 quad), g23 = x mod 32 (the high half 0), g24 = y mod 16; a
predicate on the o4 write is ignored (both complementary writes run, the last wins).  Each configuration is an x job and a y job
(a landed word's source pixel needs the pair); the direct reads (o0 alone) are single jobs, their premise (o0 = pa lands at the
pixel's own position) is tested by c-rd-pa (default triangle), c-rdf-pa (full 64x64) and c-rdf128-pa (full 128x128).  CONFIRM rows
(set `repeat`: round 2's post hoc readings, frozen now) are tallied apart from the HELD OUT rows (never run).  Controls are scoped to their group:
G-o4 (structural: tag-5 words 10..100 in each job, pairs 5..60, every pair source (even, even), tag-5' words <= 2: c-e709 and
c-o4-u) gates the o4 rows, G-o1 (tag-2 fraction >= 0.98: c-u, c-u-r2) the o1 rows, c-g23r4 the register-form rows, c-o4s-u the
swapped-order o4 rows, the three premise controls their direct reads; a failed control voids its group only.  The 128x128 rows
are last (new on hardware in this probe shape).

## q-f0

Q082 pixel side, stage q-f0: the loop controls on FILLS (10 jobs).  The first control is the relative backward `br` in a
pixel task (decision R3-P1): relative loop + MARK proof (prologue mov r30 = 0xC0DE0000 | N, last instruction xor.end o0, r1, r30),
so o0 = MARK on 2048 of 2048 only where the counter reached zero (E770's unwritten register cannot pass).  A fill's shader
sits at index 0 of the code base, so E431's absolute `ba` loop works in a fill (o0 = 0, E431/E769) and is kept here as the abs
control: never in a --tri slot (the generator and the guard refuse).  Rows: rel 53, 56, 53, 56 (proofstop: a failed proof stops
the stage with rc 17 and ends the pixel loop stages cleanly), abs 53, 56, 53, 56, rel 16 (clear, burst 204 +- 125 us), rel 136
(set, t6 120..340 us after the burst starts).  STATUS2 is read after the reset (must be 0x400) and after the job; every row
runs under regtimeline 0x0008 (clock-gate status, the burst), 0x0118 (STATUS2), 0x012c.  If abs and rel disagree on the bit
the session stops (driver exit 41): the fill ladders would have to run with both.

## q-f1b

Q082 pixel side, stage q-f1b: what the latch counts (fills, 54 jobs; order b: the exact reverse of order a).  Relative `br` loops with MARK
(decision R3-P1), STATUS2 read after the reset (0x400) and after the job, regtimeline 0x0008 / 0x0118 / 0x012c.  Ladders: b16 (14 imae,
N 6..104), b12 (10 imae, 8..136), b4 (2 imae, 40..640), b2 (no imae, 500..16000), b8n (6 `or`, 60..3840), ld8 (ldad, wdf, 4 imae,
20..320).  The first two points of a ladder are its FIT rows (the burst slope s_body); every other point is HELD OUT.  Hypotheses
(frozen in score/r3const.py): H-MA (multiply-adds of an instance >= M*, M* in (318, 336]), H-WD (a tile's time (B - 60.2) / 4 >=
121.8 us), H-WD-busy, H-BURST (B >= 536 +- 20 us); H-ITER and H-INSTR are E769's refuted rows, printed without weight.  A hypothesis is
refuted by one ladder whose two orders agree and contradict it; the orders disagreeing at one N marks that N `edge`.

## q-t

Q082 pixel side, stage q-t: occupancy with the working triangle loop (decisions R3-P1, P2, P5, P8).  `probe --tri pixel --temps 32
--width W --height H --tri-full` with the relative b8 loop + MARK: the triangle covers the whole target (the tool prints
`triangle (0,0) (3W,0) (0,3H)`), so every pixel must hold MARK.  Sizes 8x8, 16x16, 32x16, 32x32, 64x32, 128x128, 256x256; ladder
N = 4, 14, 28, 53, 56, 110, 220, 440, 880, 1760, 3520 cut where pixels x N would pass 2.3e7 (E357's longest completed fill, 112 ms).
Controls: the stock pix_green full triangle at seven sizes, the loop at N = 1 at seven sizes (MARK on W x H of W x H, else void),
and the 64x32 bridge at 53 and 56 (clear, set: the fill's threshold).  The ladders are HELD OUT.  The first ladder point with the
bit set, by hypothesis (frozen table in score/r3const.py, scaled by the measured 64x32 first set / 56): H-INST per instance
(including H-MA), H-TILE per 32x16 tile (including H-WD), H-JOB for the whole job.  E770 done right (the partial default triangle
at 64x64, N = 53, 56, 110) is exploratory.  The 4x4 rows (R3-P8) are last.  Every row runs under regtimeline and STATUS2 reads.

## q-v

Q082 TA side, stage q-v: bit 7 of CR_EVENT_STATUS2 with a looping VERTEX program (R2-geo's g-t5v; E784 measured i880 clear,
i1760 set with body 8 on 3 vertices, loop proof = the stored depth 0x3f200000 + N at every vertex).  `probe --temps 16 --pixels --tri
vtxuse --width 64 --height 64 --vtx-coords 2 [--vertices V] --dump-render ... --slot pixel=pix_green.bin LOOP`, regtimeline and STATUS2
reads.  Controls: ctl0 (no loop), n1, n3, i880, i1760.  The b8v ladder 935..1705 step 55, up then down (15 x 2), HELD OUT: one bracket
of 55 (N8*), both orders within one step.  Then b16v (13 imae, N 280..950), b4v (1 imae, 1760..9000), b8v on 12 and 48 vertices (110..1760,
28..880): frozen formulas of N8* (HV-INSTR: instructions a vertex; HV-MA: multiply-adds a vertex; HV-JOB: the job's vertices together;
HV-TIME: the burst's length).  Sweep stops (knob sweep:G:0x80) only where the work goes past E784's intact 3 x 1760 x 8 instructions:
those rows are skipped once a row of the group has set bit 7; rows inside it are `watch` rows (never skipped).
